fact: The World Bank's appraisal-stage Project Information Document of 4 November 2024 states that Liberia's Annual School Census, national learning assessment system and school quality standards are all reliant on external support and financing, and that the EXCEL project, financed by a US$33.375 million GPE grant, will help the Ministry of Education move the census to a school-based data collection system and maintain an integrated data dashboard established with USAID support; it also says poor record-keeping in schools hampers the collection of school monitoring data.
title: Project Information Document (PID): Excellence in Learning in Liberia (P181455)
